success_criteria: start from deployable P0 human-view inputs and keep actor inputs unchanged
mine candidate same-current different-history pairs with explicit physical-pair and left-step diversity
cap candidate rows per strict physical pair before boundary relocation
cover at least 10 strict physical pairs, 5 left steps, 2 target types, and 2 normal-margin buckets after robustness
run wrong-history-only boundary relocation before multi-variant replay
do not run PPO or actor updates until robustness passes
failure_criteria: reuse only the M178 accepted rows after M181 showed they are exhausted
rank solely by action distance or margin gap while ignoring pair diversity
use hidden/oracle quantities as actor inputs
promote duplicate-dominated rows into a training corpus
